note: Cube Computer (legal name Collaborators Inc.) is a very early-stage, founder-led startup (Paul Rony and Yiliu Shen-Burke) that publicly launched in August 2026 out of a16z's Speedrun accelerator (batch/cohort 'Speedrun 007'), not Y Combinator (no ycombinator.com/companies page exists for it). Funding details beyond the Speedrun program's standard up-to-$1M investment could not be confirmed from primary sources (crunchbase.com blocked the request with a Cloudflare challenge; duckduckgo/bing search endpoints returned no usable results in this environment); figures here rely on Google's AI Overview summarizing X/Twitter posts by the founder, so confidence is low-to-medium and should be re-verified against a primary source (company blog, TechCrunch, or the founders' own tweets) before being treated as final.
